content.description: Replace 48-group collapsible sidebar with 10-category flat navigation. Each category links to a hub page rendering permission-filtered module cards in a responsive grid.
capabilities: 10-category flat sidebar (Dashboard, Bookings, Sales, Vessels, Containers, Finance, Commercial, Logistics, Compliance, Admin)
9 hub pages with module card grids (sm:2, lg:3, xl:4 columns)
Module cards filtered by user permissions via canSeeModule()
Empty state when no modules visible for user role
Collapsed sidebar shows only category icons
Dashboard quick actions link to hub routes
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar renders 10 flat category items instead of 48 collapsible groups
Category only visible if user has ANY of its permission prefixes
Clicking category navigates to hub page showing module cards
Each module card links to existing module route (pages unchanged)
Collapsed sidebar shows only icons with tooltip labels
Direct URLs to existing modules (e.g. /sales-crm) still work
edge_cases: User with no permissions at all — sees only Dashboard
User with single module permission — sees only that category
Admin with wildcard permissions — sees all 10 categories
error_handling: getCategoryBySlug returns undefined for invalid slug — hub page returns 404
Empty permissions array — only Dashboard visible
